Compare two detectors on own, shared and full time

tl_compare.Rd

A common-time comparison can be fair for one question and still discard the hard periods that matter for another. tl_compare() therefore reports each detector on its own answered time, both detectors on the time when both answered, and full-period quantities, and it states how much reference-known time and how many eligible episodes the shared comparison discards.

Usage

tl_compare(ledger, detectors = attr(ledger, "detectors")[1:2], ...)

Arguments

ledger

A tl_ledger with at least two detectors.

detectors

The two detectors to compare.

...

Matching settings passed to tl_match().

Value

An object of class tl_compare: a list with own and shared (tl_metrics), own_match and shared_match (tl_match), shared_ledger, discarded (time and episodes per detector) and table (pooled estimates side by side).

Examples

fx <- tl_fixture("two_detectors")
led <- tl_ledger(fx$records, fx$reference, fx$predictions,
                 time_unit = "min")
cmp <- tl_compare(led, c("A", "B"))
